pages.title: Galactic Dynamics
pages.text: $(thing)Galactic Dynamics$()$(br2)Map how fast the Galaxy's hydrogen turns at each distance from its centre and the stars alone cannot hold it together: something unseen outweighs them several times over. Unlocks the long galactic survey.

$(thing)Insight$(): 110$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Radio Astronomy.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 4 Hydrogen Line Map, 2 Pulsar Timing Record, 2 Deep Sky Plate.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): A cloud of gas circles the centre of a galaxy at radius r, held by the gravity of the mass M inside its orbit. Write the speed v it must have to stay on a circle.
